title: three-classes-cannot-be-cast
intention: Resolve the two node classes that cannot be cast: host-seam gets a workflow version (RESEARCHME/POCME/PROVEME + deploy ticket), operational-driver retires into the probe primitive (zero members, every candidate collapses into Probe).
why: A class without a workflow is policy nothing branches on (Law 4). host-seam has real use cases (platform-dependent system work). operational-driver has zero members and its open_ruling already names the probe primitive as successor.
traces_to: Law 4 — a class without a workflow is policy nothing branches on
Law 1 — retiring operational-driver stops re-deriving the same open ruling

falsifier.proves_red: After the change: (1) /sorted accepts a cast with node_class host-seam. (2) operational-driver.json carries SUPERSEDED naming the probe primitive. (3) No existing ticket references operational-driver as its node_class.
